title: Map legacy ACCT_MASTER rows to the modern account record shape
target_requirement: Deliver migrated.py exposing convert_account(row: dict) -> dict | None that maps one legacy ACCT_MASTER row (all string values) to the modern account shape per the exact 13-key mapping table in target_spec.md: snake_case key rename, YYYYMMDD sentinel dates to None or ISO YYYY-MM-DD, CHAR(1) Y/N to bool (blank=N), blank CURR_CD to USD, NUMBER strings to float (blank=0.0), and None for soft-deleted rows.
expected_behavior: convert_account returns None for DEL_FLG='Y'; otherwise a dict with exactly the 13 modern keys and converted values: '00000000' dates become None, other dates become ISO strings, CRED_HOLD 'Y' becomes True and 'N'/blank False, blank CURR_CD becomes 'USD', numeric strings become floats with blank coercing to 0.0, and no legacy column name appears in the output.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §1).
security_expectations: No network access; module must not import network or subprocess modules.
failure_conditions: Leaking legacy column names into the output; treating the 00000000 sentinel as a real date; emitting soft-deleted rows; defaulting blank booleans to True; nondeterminism or I/O.
